## Summary
Brief summary of what this pull request does and why.

## Context
Background that helps reviewers judge purpose and impact.

## Changes
What behaves differently, grouped by the flow a user or operator sees. One bullet = one behaviour change ("before A, now B"). For example:

### <flow the user or operator sees>
- Before A, now B
- Before C, now D

### Deleted
- What is gone and what replaced it

### New config
| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<key>` | `<value>` | ... |

## Checklist
- [ ] 프로젝트의 코드 스타일과 CLAUDE.md 규약(브랜치·커밋)을 따랐습니다.
- [ ] 변경한 동작을 검증하는 테스트를 추가했습니다.
- [ ] 런타임 검증을 했습니다.
- [ ] 태스크 파일(docs/tasks/<TASK_ID>*.md)에 설계 변경과 검증 결과를 반영했습니다.

## Testing
A list of verified behaviours, then a failed list and an unverified list under `###` headings, as `<item>: <reason>`. Put the exact command in a `<details>` block.
